# Ovulation Induction — Authorization Guide
_CPT Codes · ICD-10 · Payer Requirements_

backHref: /ovulation-induction

## CPT Codes

| CPT | Description | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 58321 | Artificial insemination; intra-uterine (IUI) | IUI procedure |
| 76857 | Ultrasound, pelvic (nonobstetric), real time with image documentation; limited | Follicle monitoring |
| 76830 | Ultrasound, transvaginal | Transvaginal US |
| 82670 | Estradiol | Estradiol level |
| 83001 | Gonadotropin; follicle stimulating hormone (FSH) | FSH level |
| 83002 | Gonadotropin; luteinizing hormone (LH) | LH level |
| 96372 | Therapeutic, prophylactic, or diagnostic injection; subcutaneous or intramuscular | Injection admin |
| J3490 | Unclassified drugs (letrozole, clomiphene) | Oral OI agents |
| J0725 | Chorionic gonadotropin per 1,000 USP units (hCG trigger) | hCG trigger |
| S9560 | Home infusion therapy, subcutaneous therapy; administrative services | Home injection |

**Injectable Gonadotropin NDC Codes (for pharmacy PA)**
Follitropin alfa (Gonal-F): J3490 or specific NDC | Follitropin beta (Follistim): J3490 | Menotropins (Menopur): J3490 | Urofollitropin (Bravelle): J3490

## ICD-10 Diagnoses

| ICD-10 | Description |
| --- | --- |
| N97.0 | Female infertility associated with anovulation |
| E28.2 | Polycystic ovarian syndrome |
| E28.0 | Estrogen excess |
| E23.0 | Hypopituitarism (hypothalamic anovulation) |
| E22.1 | Hyperprolactinemia |
| E03.9 | Hypothyroidism, unspecified |
| E05.90 | Thyrotoxicosis, unspecified |
| Z31.41 | Encounter for fertility testing |
| Z31.83 | Encounter for assisted reproductive fertility procedure cycle |

## Coverage Landscape

**Common Denial Reasons**
- Injectable gonadotropins denied as "not medically necessary"
- "Benefit exclusion" for infertility medications
- Monitoring ultrasounds denied as "excessive frequency"
- Letrozole denied (off-label for ovulation induction — FDA approved for breast cancer)

**Strongest Coverage Arguments**
- PCOS (E28.2) is a diagnosable endocrine disorder — treatment is medically necessary
- Letrozole: ASRM/Endocrine Society first-line recommendation for PCOS (Legro NEJM 2014)
- Monitoring ultrasounds are medically necessary to prevent OHSS and multiple gestation
- State mandate may apply to medications if plan covers infertility treatment

## Prior Authorization Requirements

### Required Documentation
- Diagnosis of anovulation with specific etiology (PCOS, hypothalamic, etc.)
- Hormonal workup: FSH, LH, estradiol, prolactin, TSH, AMH
- Documentation of failed oral agent trials (letrozole, clomiphene) before injectables
- Tubal patency confirmed (HSG or SHG)
- Normal semen analysis (or male factor addressed)
- Letter of medical necessity from REI or OB/GYN
- For injectables: documentation of failed oral OI (typically 3–6 cycles)
